purpose: Frozen semantic review criteria for legal-claims-v1; literal grounding alone is not accuracy.

office-subordination: fact: office is subordinate to the ministry, not a duty imposed on either
bank-register-fields: obligation: register must contain the listed fields, including name and address
shareholder-payment: obligation: each shareholder pays the full subscribed value
retain monetary form, full payment and constitution timing for capital payments
bank-capital-deadline: obligation: authorized banks and banks with constitution approval are the subject
retain deadline 30 aprilie 2000 and minimum reference to art. 1
agent-prohibitions: prohibition: taking orders otherwise than directly and personally from the owner
obligation: owner supplies ownership and identity documents
S.V.M. prohibition is conditional on verification, not a blanket ban on orders
exception-preservation: keep exceptional circumstances AND express president/director approval on the same restricted-conduct claim
retain the explanation of exceptional circumstances
explicit-abbreviations: definitions retain local regulation scope and are not obligations
confidential-information: access is limited and requires president's order, not unconditionally permitted
broadcast-exclusions: majority calculation excludes news, sports, games, advertising and teletext
40% is of European content broadcast, not all airtime
10% independent production retains reference to preceding paragraphs
quoted replacement rules retain amendment context
banking-act-identities: amendment targets Normele nr. 2/1999 with both affected annex paragraphs
laws 101/1998 and 58/1998 are legal bases, not amendment targets
nested-amendment-identities: right: Academy members receive indemnity, not beneficiary obligation
historical approval concerns OUG 78/1997 approved by Law 17/1999
replacement article is not identified as Article 1 of the amending act
missing-body: empty claims; runtime folder ingestion should defer this unavailable body
